items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to release claimed refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar date ('bis zum 27.11.2026') for the alleged fee payment rather than a period to be counted, so this date is used as written, with no statutory delivery-fiction or weekend/holiday adjustment applied (those rules govern periods set by authorities/companies for legitimate claims, not an arbitrary deadline in what appears to be a fraudulent demand).

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of an advance-fee scam: it claims a refund is 'released' but demands an upfront 'Bearbeitungsgebühr' before any payout is made — a classic fraud pattern.

The payment IBAN (CY17 ...) is a Cypriot bank account; a genuine German consumer-refund scheme for energy costs would not route payments through a foreign offshore account, and there is no known official German body called 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie'.

The letter uses high-pressure tactics ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig.') and an unusually short deadline (7 days) to rush the recipient into paying without checking — typical of scam letters.
The sender's address (Avenue Beispiel 14, 1065 Nicosia, Zypern) and the placeholder-sounding street name are inconsistent with a credible German consumer authority.

Recommendation: do not transfer any money to this IBAN, do not reply with personal/bank details, and report the letter to the Verbraucherzentrale NRW and/or the police; genuine refunds (e.g. from utility providers or the Verbraucherzentrale) never require an upfront fee.
